xterm.js 5.5.0 (MIT), modified 2026-10-15 for isolated TerminalSurfacePrototype research.
Original source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@xterm/xterm/-/xterm-5.5.0.tgz
Preserve xterm-LICENSE with experimental distributions.

XtermSource/combined-cell-limit.patch modifies:
- src/common/buffer/BufferLine.ts: experimental 256 UTF-16-unit combined-cell guard,
  checked numerically before append/scalar creation; guards imported combined values.
- src/common/input/WriteBuffer.ts: catches only the dedicated limit exception,
  permanently revokes that writer, clears pending data/callbacks and reports the
  fixed 'combined-cell-limit' code via an experimental write callback extension.
  No remaining chunk is parsed and no success acknowledgment is issued on failure.

Web/xterm.js is rebuilt from the patched source using the pinned isolated esbuild
build in XtermSource. It is not the original npm bundle. TypeScript declaration
files containing const enums are resolved as source by the build tool. This is a
research-only modified API, not an accepted production output-loss/session policy.
XtermSource/accessibility-limit.patch additionally modifies:
- src/browser/AccessibilityManager.ts: prospective pending/live aggregate limit
  (16,384 UTF-16 units), echo queue limits (256 entries, 1,024 units total,
  16 units per entry), blur/disposal clearing and guarded key/render callbacks.
- src/common/ExperimentalAccessibility.ts: fixed content-free dedicated error.
- src/common/input/WriteBuffer.ts: both fixed failure codes, pending/queued write
  revocation and fenced asynchronous/reentrant continuations.
- src/common/CoreTerminal.ts and src/browser/Types.d.ts: research-only accessibility
  failure event/entry point for failures outside an active parser write.

Accessibility remains enabled. These guards do not bound renderer width-cache
retention, browser heap or overall RSS and do not establish screen-reader
acceptance or a production terminal policy.
